scope: Locally available committed VLA-OFT evidence through cutoff; no new GPU experiment in consolidation

protocol.formal_protocol: 10 tasks x 50 official initial states, paired model/env seeds
protocol.implementation: BF16 stored fake-quant weights; no packed-kernel efficiency result
protocol.teacher_mse: relative to BF16 teacher, not ground-truth action error
protocol.repeat_policy: Source snapshots may overlap; do not sum datasets as independent observations

authoritative_baseline.note: Fixed tasks, paired official init indices; p value not equivalence; fake quant precision only

clip_factorial.note: Language-only W2; vision BF16; identical original AWQ scales. Q/K weight clipping naturally absent in all four cases.

positive_development_pair.note: Outcome oracle uses test outcomes; only a complementarity upper bound, not routing performance or training data.

negative_development_pair.note: Outcome oracle uses test outcomes; only a complementarity upper bound, not routing performance or training data.

not_measured: packed INT2/INT4 total bytes, peak VRAM and synchronized latency
file_hash_policy: SHA256 of canonical LF bytes for CSV/JSON/Markdown/Python/text/SVG; binary PNG uses original bytes. bytes fields record local source size. Embedded profile and upstream hashes retain their own original conventions.
diagnostic_index_policy: Sources are indexed by relative path, SHA256 and byte count. Large arrays and CSV rows remain in their source files and are not duplicated here. Authoritative result summaries above retain the measured counts.
reproduction: python scripts/build_experiment_summary.py (numpy/matplotlib; no network or GPU)
large_artifacts: Source videos/profile/NPZ are in separately SHA-verified server and local archives; models/calibration/original profiles are not fully offsite-backed-up
